terms.gloss: run together, flock to one place; rush together in battle, clash
evidence: Cic. Q. Fr. 1.2.16: tōta Ītalia concurret (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Agr. 2.13: concurrunt jussū meō plūrēs ūnō tempore librāriī (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: serpit per colōniam fāma; concurrere omnēs
phrases.english: the story creeps through the town; everyone comes running

sources: Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
